plan.run_id: new independent original-owner purpose; no active or old root reuse
plan.requested_roles: one or two distinct roles from the original eight-role catalog, ordered exactly like entries
plan.deferred_roles: exact complement of requested_roles; metadata only, never added to pending or initialized
plan.entries: only requested role entries, with original job_root, family, role_key, teacher, seed, batch and all source/assets metadata

entry.num_envs: unchanged original allowed batch; full resume requires exact source batch/layout/schema
entry.seed: retain selected original task seed, not replaced by this executor

microtrain.target_verified_increment: strict integer 1 through 300; an execution plan, not an acceptance threshold or promise
microtrain.source_final: null for FRESH; for RESUME: actual producer production/FINAL.json descriptor {path, bytes, SHA, metadata}
microtrain.declared_source_counts: all nine original counters, derived from actual byte-pinned FINAL, or all zero for FRESH
microtrain.target_cumulative_verified_counter: source verified counter plus requested increment; recomputed from actual restored counts before train

entry.target_bptt_steps: optional before plan normalization; if present must equal the derived cumulative target; mandatory in actual task/GO
entry.resume_bptt: existing OWN_NEW_BPTT_FULL_CHECKPOINT_V2 descriptor, raw35 same family, allow_environment_reset=true, allow_partial_update=false; additionally producer_role_key binds payload and actual FINAL

source_FINAL_binding.actual_byte_read: future owner reads the bounded FINAL JSON once and checks bytes/SHA; never opens/stats/hashes a PT before original admission
source_FINAL_binding.source_checkpoint: actual FINAL checkpoint must match resume path/SHA/bytes/counts and own production/checkpoints/*_complete.pt
source_FINAL_binding.lineage: actual FINAL, resume descriptor and decoded payload agree on producer run, role/key, raw35 family and all nine counters
source_FINAL_binding.not_claimed: source FINAL metadata is not a new skill qualification, paired cohort or native close proof

loaded_baseline.read_order: original GO and leases -> original SDK/fresh single reset/teacher -> original one-byte full checkpoint cache -> new payload-lineage metadata check -> original full strict loader -> read actual restored counts -> derive target
loaded_baseline.full_resume: unchanged four models, four optimizers, replay, RNG, counters, iteration/sim counters; retained whole payload, one physical open/hash/decode
loaded_baseline.history: saved history stays in source payload; fresh-environment branch seals replay stream boundary and zeroes live history for original fresh padding; no extra env reset after load
loaded_baseline.no_migration: no actor-only fallback, no cross-view slicing, no fresh count offset, no bound/H32/reward/command changes

saved_segment.late_STOP: unchanged before_action stop/deadline/disk gate; complete original save and close still required; partial or zero achieved increments reported honestly
saved_segment.parent_semantic: unchanged original actual-wait/App fast-close gate first; only then exact segment/lineage/count/FINAL-checkpoint consistency checks; no original error cleared

original_resources_unchanged.canonical: one original C, original b.charge_values, two original authority EX, private GPU EX, training finite SH
original_resources_unchanged.conservative_one_role_behavior: original two-GPU lock/admission and RESERVE+7800 preGO rule retained even for one requested role
original_resources_unchanged.charge: actual GO through teacher/load, model/replay restore, WM/BPTT, full save, SDK close and actual parent wait; no refund/clamp/new ledger
original_resources_unchanged.protected: whole owner main after only enumerated target/metadata normalization; original account/environment/admit/gpu/plan_protocol functions byte-logical AST; original worker algorithm, reset, teacher full-state device guard, loader and close body

deferred_validation.quality_feedback_decision: future executing parent only after actual frozen quality evidence; never auto-enable
